title: Player Movement System
explanation: WASD movement system from PlayerController. Sets velocity based on arrow keys and plays directional walk animations.

title: Dialogue Branching Logic
explanation: DialogueTree branching system. Processes player choices and navigates to next dialogue node or ends conversation.

title: Real-Time Server Stats
explanation: Express API endpoint that powers the server stats overlay. Collects CPU, memory, and process info in real-time.

title: Access Code Validation
explanation: Backend endpoint that validates speakeasy door codes. Checks MongoDB for active passes and generates guest JWT tokens.

title: Camera Follow System
explanation: Phaser camera that smoothly follows the player with lerp interpolation. Constrained to map bounds for pixel-perfect scrolling.

title: Typewriter Text Animation
explanation: Character-by-character text reveal used in the cinematic intro. 50ms delay between characters creates typewriter effect.

title: Tile Collision Detection
explanation: Phaser collision system that reads Tiled map properties. Prevents player from walking through walls and buildings.

title: NPC Proximity Detection
explanation: NPCManager proximity check that detects when player is close enough to talk. Uses Euclidean distance calculation.

title: Building-to-App Navigation
explanation: WorldNavigationService that bridges Phaser game world to Angular routes. Saves player position for seamless returns.

title: Fade Scene Transition
explanation: Smooth fade-to-black transition between Phaser scenes. Used in cinematic intro when player clicks Enter button.

title: Responsive Canvas Scaling
explanation: Phaser config that makes the game canvas responsive. Fits to browser window while maintaining aspect ratio.

title: Floating Particle Effect
codeSnippet:
const particles = this.add.particles(0, 0, 'particle', {
  x: { min: 0, max: width },
  y: { min: height, max: height + 50 },
  speedY: { min: -50, max: -30 },
  speedX: { min: -10, max: 10 },
  scale: { start: 0.5, end: 0 },
  alpha: { start: 0.8, end: 0 },
  lifespan: 4000,
  frequency: 200,
  tint: [0x00ffff, 0xffffff, 0x4da6ff]
});
explanation: Phaser particle system creating ambient floating dots in the cinematic intro. Cyan/white particles drift upward and fade out.

title: MongoDB Pass Analytics
explanation: MongoDB aggregation pipeline for pass manager analytics. Groups passes by creator and counts active vs inactive codes.

title: Door Shake Animation
explanation: Door rattle effect in DoorScene when invalid code is entered. Rapid left-right shake provides tactile feedback.

title: Auth0 JWT Validation
explanation: Express middleware that validates JWT tokens from Auth0. Protects authenticated routes like pass manager and dashboard.
